hook_en: Before you worry, call on Him. 🙏
reflect_en: Midweek pressure has a way of pulling us toward panic. David's first move was praise: he called on the God who is worthy, and trusted Him with the outcome.
q_en: What do you need to call on Him about today?
x_en: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised
tiktok: Before you worry, call on Him 🙏 Psalm 18:3 — what are you bringing to God today?
yt_title: Call Upon the LORD, Who Is Worthy to Be Praised | Psalm 18:3 #Shorts
li_open: Where does your first reaction go under pressure?
li_quote: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
li_body: David's habit was to turn to God first, and to do it with praise rather than panic. Teams and congregations take their cue from how their leaders respond when things get hard, and a praying leader sets a steady tone.
hook_es: Antes de preocuparte, clama a Él. 🙏
reflect_es: A mitad de semana la presión nos empuja a la ansiedad. Lo primero que hizo David fue alabar: invocó al Dios que es digno y confió en Él.
q_es: ¿Por qué necesitas clamar a Él hoy?
x_es: Invocaré a Jehová, digno de ser alabado, y seré salvo de mis enemigos.
key_en: I will call upon the LORD
